question.prompt: Julie is preparing a speech for her class. Her speech must last between one-half hour and three-quarters of an hour. The ideal rate of speech is \(150\) words per minute. If Julie speaks at the ideal rate, which of the following number of words would be an appropriate length for her speech?

solutions.explanation:
The speaking rate is measured per minute, so first express both time limits in minutes. One-half hour is \(30\) minutes, and three-quarters of an hour is \(45\) minutes.

Multiply each duration by \(150\) words per minute to find the corresponding word limits:
\[
150\cdot30=4500,
\qquad
150\cdot45=6750.
\]
Only \(5650\) is between these limits; every other choice is below \(4500\). Thus an appropriate length is \(\boxed{5650}\) words, choice \(\mathrm{E}\).
solutions.title: Convert the time limits to word counts
